gaps.sentence: They're ___ (HOPE) that the talks will resume.
gaps.explanation: 'Be hopeful that…' = feeling hope; 'hopefully' is the adverb.

gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).

gaps.explanation: 'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: She gave a moving ___ (PERFORM) of the sonata.
gaps.explanation: 'A performance of the sonata' — the act of performing.

gaps.sentence: The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see
gaps.explanation: 'Visibility' = the distance you can see; paired with 'poor'.
Negative prefix for 'legal' is 'il-' before l: illegal.
